Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the right-hand lane on a Conroe, Texas roadway when Driver 2 attempted a lane change into
the same space and made contact with the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported a concussion following the
impact and was assessed at the scene. Officers confirmed that Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time
of the collision, and this was also consistent with statements given at the scene. The damage to the left side of Driver
1's vehicle is consistent with the sideswipe described, and the scene photographs show the same contact points. No
independent witnesses were located to observe the lane change. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle is known to
the reporting officer. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. The injury described is
consistent with the type and force of the collision as observed at the scene.
